gaps: Source gives no region or location for the story-reward and legendary-ship models.
The mapping of 'Brothers in Arms' to the Fearless/Royal Sovereign pair is inferred from the source's listing of it among legendary ship models.
notes: All 20 fill Art Collection slots on the shelf in the Fleet Planning room at Great Inagua Manor, count toward the Dilettante trophy/achievement and show under Codex > Database > Art Collection: Ship Models. Identification: cutters are smallest, schooners small merchants, brigs have a front ram, frigates are medium with no ram, Man o' Wars are the large warships; the spyglass shows ship type.
